title: Fireworks
description: Particle shells burst over a castle on a lake. Each burst leaves a flash that is a point light for the castle and the hills, and the smoke takes the same light from every side. The water only reflects the bursts. A second set of passes draws the scene through a mirrored camera, and the water samples that picture through its ripples. The exposure adapts like an eye: a volley darkens the picture, and the exposure rises again afterwards. The castle and pines are from Kenney's Castle Kit and Nature Kit (CC0).
line: Each burst is a point light over a castle reflected in a lake.
hint: click the sky to fire a shell · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
